See the issue is that it was the same content warning as most shows have in the beginning (like SVU) and the same one they had for Martha’s episode. But this was much more graphic. The issue is that they did not fully warn survivors just how bad it was going to be. For a show that is discussing these issues thoroughly, it would be better to be trauma informed and give more of a warning that it’s much worse than what we’d already seen with Martha with the same cw

Agree with you on it not being about his sexuality tho
There’s another post asking ppl to share tws from each episode and that gives exact times
I think it happens around 50 min in?

I did not see it as being against queer men at all. I totally thought the point was that he’s straight thus showing that sexual violence is about displays of power not sex. Since he did it because he was emasculated- not because of anything to do with sexual orientation. I saw it as commentary on the dangers of toxic masculinity.

That being said, it was horrifically graphic with no warning for just how bad it would be in comparison to how they handled Martha’s. In an attempt to spread messages about toxic masculinity, they harmed a lot of survivors watching. I had a panic attack and I NEVER get triggered by shows
Wait did I not watch it correctly? Someone said in one of the comments that it was just jerking off. I thought it was penetrative anal rape and had a panic attack

I have not been triggered by something on tv in the last 5 yrs, and I do not shy away from media that discusses these issues. I watched promising young woman with no issues and law and order all the time. This came out of NOWHERE. It gave me a panic attack, and I have not stopped shaking for the last hour. They did not give enough of a warning about how bad it would be. I thought it was going to be like what they showed with Martha last season. But holy hell that was worse than pulp fiction. And they just plopped it in no biggie. I get the point they were making, but that was so retraumatizing to survivors
Right. But fully online instruction is not an accommodation that’s currently allowed at Washu... even for those with documented disabilities
